protocol.calibrated_confidence_gate: Research bucket only; production Confidence3-5 prohibited until prospective minimum500 decided bucket cases (800 for5),20 weeks,two seasons,ECE<=.03,lower95 bound>.52381,stable folds,and owner approval.
protocol.dependence: At most one selection per game. Report shared teams across weeks and pairwise overlap. No forced ATS/totals allocation.
protocol.fallback: Mandatory contest picks may remain Confidence1. When calibrated ranking unavailable, mark the whole ranking UNVALIDATED_FALLBACK and sort by market,canonical matchup,side for reproducibility only. Never describe tie-break order as quality.
protocol.prospective_promotion: At least20 untouched future evaluation weeks; paired week-block95 MAE difference<0 versus line and baseline in each promoted market, Brier improvement, ranking AUC lower95>.5, combined-five unit difference lower95>0 versus strongest preregistered incumbent, no unexplained severe subgroup instability. Familywise multiple-candidate adjustment required. No threshold tuning on holdout.
